changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Add system_managed column to adapter_config table.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE adapter_config ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS system_managed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Auto-provision IN_APP and EMAIL adapter configs for all existing users without them.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO adapter_config (user_id, organization_id, adapter_type, label, config, enabled, system_managed) SELECT u.id, NULL, 'IN_APP', 'In-App Notifications', '{}'::jsonb, true, true FROM "user" u WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM adapter_config ac WHERE ac.user_id = u.id AND ac.adapter_type = 'IN_APP' AND ac.organization_id IS NULL );
INSERT INTO adapter_config (user_id, organization_id, adapter_type, label, config, enabled, system_managed) SELECT u.id, NULL, 'EMAIL', 'Email Notifications', '{}'::jsonb, true, true FROM "user" u WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM adapter_config ac WHERE ac.user_id = u.id AND ac.adapter_type = 'EMAIL' AND ac.organization_id IS NULL );

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN adapter_config.system_managed IS 'Whether this configuration is system-managed and cannot be deleted by the user';
